title: Coordinate legal review of ‘measurement and billing’ language updates (metering + dispute clause)
creator: Chris Osei
description:
Goal
- Coordinate Legal review and approval of updated ‘measurement and billing’ language for Redwood Inference MSAs/Order Forms, aligned to current product meters and known edge cases.
- Ensure the language is consistent across: (1) contract templates, (2) internal metering guidance, (3) customer-facing explanations used by Sales/CS.

Why
- We are running pricing/packaging experiments and tightening billing controls. Contract language needs to be explicit about what we measure, how we aggregate, what counts as billable usage (incl. retries/failed requests), dispute window, and audit rights.
- We’ve had recurring confusion from customers comparing Console usage vs invoice totals; Legal wants a clean, defensible reference to product documentation and a clear dispute process.

Scope
In-scope
- ‘Measurement and Billing’ clause wording updates (definitions + dispute window + audit rights boundaries + treatment of retries/failed requests/partial streaming).
- Align references to canonical metering definitions and invoice line item mapping.
- Timeline/rollout plan for applying language to new MSAs and amendments.

Out-of-scope
- Redrafting full contract templates beyond the measurement/billing section (unless required by counsel).
- Changes to revenue recognition policy.

Deliverables
1) Final approved clause language (GC + Commercial Counsel) ready to paste into templates.
2) Confluence page updated as internal source of truth (and linked from enablement FAQ).
3) Sales Ops guidance: when the updated clause is required (new MSAs vs amendments; exceptions; what to do with redlines).
4) Release note for internal teams (Sales/CS/Finance) with the effective date.

Key stakeholders
- Legal: Sofia Mendes (commercial counsel), Michael Grant (GC)
- Finance: Laura Bennett, Emily Stone
- RevOps/Sales Ops: Isabelle Laurent
- Product Ops: Chris Osei

References / working links
- Confluence draft: sources/confluence/finance-and-legal/contracts-and-legal-process/metering-measurement-language-guidance.json
- Meter dictionary: sources/confluence/finance-and-legal/revrec-and-billing/hosted-api-meter-definitions-v3.json
- Invoice mapping: sources/confluence/finance-and-legal/revrec-and-billing/invoice-line-item-mapping-to-telemetry.json

Open questions to resolve with counsel
- Dispute window: 30 vs 60 days from invoice date; whether ‘undisputed amounts’ must still be paid on time.
- Audit rights: allow customer audit of ‘records’ limited to usage logs/aggregates; frequency limits; cost-shifting; confidentiality.
- Retries/failed requests: confirm language that (a) successful responses are billable, (b) non-response failures generally not billable, (c) platform retries and client retries treated differently when usage is emitted.
- Streaming: clarify that partial completions prior to disconnect are billable; tokens after disconnect are not billed (align with current engineering policy) and how we evidence this.
- Documentation reference: whether we reference a specific URL/doc name or ‘usage documentation as updated from time to time’ with notice.

Acceptance criteria
- Sofia + Michael approve final language (written confirmation) and provide a ‘clean’ version.
- Isabelle confirms updated language is in the correct template(s) and is being used for all new MSAs starting effective date.
- Finance confirms clause does not conflict with billing dispute runbook and internal controls.
- Internal Confluence page reflects final language and has links to meter definitions + dispute process.

Timeline (target)
- 2026-01-16: send consolidated draft + list of edge cases to Legal
- 2026-01-23: receive first redlines, review with Finance/Sales Ops
- 2026-01-30: finalize wording + confirm effective date for new MSAs
- 2026-02-07: rollout complete (templates updated + internal comms)

Notes
- This ticket is blocked on counsel feedback cadence; keep changes small and explicit to avoid opening broader template negotiations.
- If customer counsel pushes for stronger audit rights, route to Michael Grant for final position and maintain a default ‘standard stance’ for AEs.
comments: 2026-01-10 (Chris Osei): Kicking this off after last week’s reconciliation sync. Primary issue: customers compare Console vs invoice; we need contract language that points to the canonical meter definitions and clarifies aggregation/rounding + dispute process. Drafting a consolidated ‘edge cases’ appendix for Sofia.

2026-01-16 (Isabelle Laurent): Pulled current MSA language from template. It references ‘records’ but doesn’t define what we provide in a dispute; also no explicit streaming treatment. Sending to Sofia with proposed structure and a standard 30-day dispute window (Finance preference).

2026-01-22 (Sofia Mendes): Reviewed draft. Main edits: add requirement that undisputed amounts remain payable; narrow audit rights to (i) usage summaries and (ii) verification of invoiced amounts (not underlying infrastructure). Also recommend explicitly defining ‘Usage Data’ and allowing Redwood to update measurement methodology provided it does not materially disadvantage customer.

2026-01-24 (Laura Bennett): Finance request: keep dispute window at 30 days; if 60 days needed for enterprise, require VP Finance approval and ensure we can still close with predictable reserve. Also add language that credits/refunds are the sole remedy for overcharge (no consequential damages carve-out debate).

2026-01-28 (Michael Grant): Approved approach with one change: do not promise raw telemetry export in contract; offer it as ‘reasonably sufficient detail’ to validate invoice. Keep audit frequency limits (1x/year) and require NDA + mutually agreed auditor.
2026-02-03 (Isabelle Laurent): Implemented final clause in new MSA template + Order Form addendum; created internal note for AEs on effective date. Shared with Sales leadership for awareness.

2026-02-10 (Chris Osei): Updated Confluence ‘metering measurement language guidance’ with clean final wording + rationale + redline handling. Linked from pricing/metering enablement FAQ. Marking as done pending one last confirmation from Sofia.

2026-02-20 (Sofia Mendes): Confirmed final language is approved and consistent with current dispute runbook; no further changes required. Please ensure any customer-requested deviation routes through Legal queue.
result: Final ‘measurement and billing’ clause approved by Legal (Sofia Mendes + Michael Grant), added to templates for new MSAs effective 2026-02-07, and published internally with Sales Ops guidance + links to canonical meter definitions.
